item.title: De vintage verhalenbundel
item.description: Deze bundel is vooral bedoeld om te laten zien waar elke kunstenaar begint. Het bevat in totaal een stuk of 15 pogingen tot verhalen schrijven, waarbij sommige afkwamen en veelbelovend waren, en andere niet verder kwamen dan een paar hoofdstukken. De allereerste pogingen tot boeken waren natuurlijk handgeschreven, ergens in een schoolschriftje, toen Tiamo nauwelijks kon lezen en schrijven. Die zijn verloren aan de tand des tijds—en waren, gezien zijn handschrift, waarschijnlijk toch niet te ontcijferen.

item.title: About
item.description: Prologue Once upon a time, there was a boy who liked to play. He made nice games, he wrote fun books, and he's still doing that today. But as he grew older, maybe wiser, he realized a fact. The universe? It ran on money, and now he needed some of that! Thus he set out to create a store, but not just one of any kind. One with special rules and products, which are only here to find.

item.title: Curriculum
item.description: Curriculum All educational systems around the world use different names, grades, guidelines, and tests. Additionally, many of these are simply wrong, because people progress and develop at different speeds and in different ways. That’s why we simplified our system to a handful of “levels”. In the curriculum below, we state the grade or age range that is typically associated with it, based on four countries (USA, UK, AU and NL).

item.title: FAQ
item.description: Click on a question below to get its answer. Hopefully, this settles any worry about using our webshop, and enlightens you about how this magical place came to be. Also, there are a few jokes to find. Payment & Security What currencies are supported? All prices and transactions are in euros (EUR, €). The system supports any other currency, though, and will automatically convert based on the exchange rate at time of purchase.

item.title: My First Letters
item.description: We recommend starting with the digital quizzes in this subject instead, which allow playing sounds. Why? Firstly, when someone hasn’t learned about language yet, they obviously can’t do exercises that require reading or writing. Secondly, because our brains have evolved to learn language through speech far more easily than any other way. After doing those fun letter sound quizzes, the transition into matching those sounds to visual shapes becomes quite seamless (e.

item.title: My First Vocabulary
item.description: This resource takes knowledge of individual alphabet letters, and perhaps a few syllables already, and advances that to reach recognition of words. Children are able to recognize “this is a word” (or, more generally, “this is a standalone chunk of a sentence”) surprisingly early. Attaching meaning and reading/writing the actual word are, of course, a much bigger leap. This resource aims to bridge that gap. Once satisfied with this, we recommend continuing to My First Stories.

item.title: Philosophy
item.description: The New Education Here at The Wayward Melody we have a pretty unique philosophy when it comes to education (and life in general). All our experience, all the evidence we’ve seen, all the logic we can muster, points in one and the same direction. Our educational systems all around the world are heavily flawed at best and actively damaging at worst. Learning is awesome, learning is life, but the common views and policies around “education” make it ineffective and even inhumane.

item.title: Privacy Policy
item.description: This online store uses the following services. Click the link to read their privacy policy. Mollie (Privacy Policy) Snipcart (Privacy Policy) CloudFlare (Privacy Policy) The Wayward Melody itself does not track, store or ask for any personal data. We don’t care and we’re not interested in joining all the dark magic happening there! Especially not because it always comes at the cost of user experience, website speed, and general happiness.

item.title: Terms & Conditions
item.description: Last updated: July 26, 2025 Magician’s Note: This is all standard legal talk with nothing special in it, just to make sure we don’t get into sticky situations if someone intents to harm our store. The most noteworthy sections are probably the fact that we really do not track/store/advertise anything, that both physical and digital goods can’t be returned, and that you must be mindful of communication with us (such as sending ideas) as we might get into copyright issues then.
